_comment: Phase 2, seeded before the full ~40-case physical golden set (PROJECT_CONTEXT.md §6). Two case types: 'query' cases run a pipeline end-to-end and check retrieved + recommended frames against hard constraints (no LLM judge). 'catalog_composition' and 'derivation_function' cases check the contested thresholds in app/lib/config/thresholds.ts directly, independent of any pipeline.

query_cases.query: Titanium frames under 8000 rupees, in stock
query_cases.note: Control case -- a query where valid candidates are plentiful enough that naive retrieval can land on a correct answer by chance.

Targets catalog intentional gap #1 (validate.py asserts this combination is empty). Correct answer: name the violated constraint and offer the nearest alternative, not a bare refusal -- see decisions.md 2026-08-28, 'refusal framing correction'.
Targets catalog intentional gap #3. Ideal answer recommends Basalt Form 448 (the nearest miss, ₹4,800) but names the ₹300 overage explicitly rather than burying it.
Not an intentional gap -- just far enough out of range (cheapest catalog frame is nowhere near ₹500) that even the naive baseline refuses correctly.

catalog_composition_cases.description: How many progressive_ready frames clear the lens-height floor at the old (30mm), current (32mm), and optician-cited (44mm) thresholds.

derivation_function_cases.description: At rx_power = -3.5D, does app/lib/derivation.ts#deriveRimTypeConstraint require non-rimless construction under the old (-4.00D), current (-3.00D), and optician-cited (-2.00D) thresholds?
